sloka: अथ दीर्घेण कालेन रूप यौवनशालिनः ।षष्टिः पुत्र सहस्राणि सगरस्य अभवन् तदा ॥१-३८-१९॥
transliteration: atha dīrgheṇa kālena rūpa yauvanaśālinaḥ ।ṣaṣṭiḥ putra sahasrāṇi sagarasya abhavan tadā ॥1-38-19॥

translations.english: Then, after a long time Sagara's sixty thousand sons attained beauty and youth.
